metadata.purpose: Local readable research corpus; never included in the website build
metadata.server_example_policy: At most one reviewed example per meter
metadata.corpus_method: Archive metadata/scan discovery + Wikisource transcription cross-check + current chandas.org detector + conservative triage
metadata.scope_note: Offline research only; these records are not loaded by the website

rawDefinition.name: ādivarāha (Jayakīrti)
rawDefinition.notes: Uses the Jayakīrti VBBBB signature under the distinct Ādivarāha name, avoiding a collision with Nāgavarma's Chandovatamsa.

rawDefinition.name: akkarike (Nāgavarma)
rawDefinition.notes: Implements Nāgavarma's V-B-V-B-V-R aṃśa signature. Historical yati placement remains advisory until a larger approved corpus is available.

rawDefinition.name: aṃśa ṣaṭpadi
signatureLines: VV | VV | VVR / VV | VV | VVR
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the complete six-line aṃśa Ṣaṭpadi frame and supplies karṣaṇa guidance for each matched aṃśa.

signatures.signature: VV | VV | VVR / VV | VV | VVR

rawDefinition.name: anuṣṭubh (pathyā)
rawDefinition.notes: This rule set recognizes pathyā Anuṣṭubh in four one-pāda lines or two complete 8+8 half-verse units. Vipulā variations are not yet accepted.

source.title: A Study on the Sanskrit Meter: Anuṣṭubh

rawDefinition.name: āṭaveladi (Telugu)
signatureLines: S = Sūrya; I = Indra; yati joins gaṇas 1 and 4
rawDefinition.notes: The canonical Vemana/śataka frame. Prāsa is not required; full traditional yati-maitri equivalence is reported conservatively.

signatures.signature: S = Sūrya; I = Indra; yati joins gaṇas 1 and 4

rawDefinition.name: bhāminī ṣaṭpadi
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the alternating three/four-mātrā gaṇas across the complete six-line verse. Literary constraints remain provisional pending expert corpus review.

rawDefinition.name: bhoga ṣaṭpadi
rawDefinition.notes: Checks all six quantitative lines and their short/extended relationship. The final two-mātrā cadence may be a Guru or resolved Laghu pair. Literary constraints remain provisional.

rawDefinition.name: chandovatamsa (Nāgavarma)
rawDefinition.notes: Keeps Nāgavarma's three Viṣṇu plus one Brahma signature canonical while accepting the reviewed VRVB second line and VVVV third line as unmarked contracted realizations. Jayakīrti's different VBBBB frame is cataloged separately as Ādivarāha.

rawDefinition.name: aṃśa chaupadi (Kannada)
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the compact V+R aṃśa frame described for Kannada Chaupadi. It remains distinct from Kagga's narrower pañcamātrā form.

rawDefinition.name: mātrā chaupadi (historical Kannada)
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the broader historical 5+5+5+3 mātrā Chaupadi family without conflating it with the modal Kagga stanza.

rawDefinition.name: doreyakkara
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the classical six-gaṇa frame. The source records broad optional substitutions, which await an expert-reviewed corpus.

rawDefinition.name: dvipada (Telugu)
signatureLines: yati joins the openings of gaṇas 1 and 3; dvitīyākṣara-prāsa joins the pair
rawDefinition.notes: The regular Telugu narrative couplet. Manjari dvipada is the same rhythmic frame without compulsory dvitīyākṣara-prāsa.

signatures.signature: yati joins the openings of gaṇas 1 and 3; dvitīyākṣara-prāsa joins the pair

rawDefinition.name: eḍeyakkara
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the classical four-gaṇa frame. Optional sung substitutions remain explicitly provisional.

rawDefinition.name: eḷe (Kannada)
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the two-line aṃśa frame, first-line yati, opening dvitīyākṣara-prāsa, and the internal recurrence in the first line's third gaṇa.

rawDefinition.name: kanda (Kannada)
signatureLines: gaṇas 6 & 14: LGL or LLLL; 8 & 16 end G
rawDefinition.notes: Implements the rhythmic, yati, and dvitīyākṣara-prāsa rules in the cited rule packet. The entry remains provisional until the golden corpus is approved.

signatures.signature: gaṇas 6 & 14: LGL or LLLL; 8 & 16 end G

rawDefinition.name: kandamu (Telugu)
signatureLines: gaṇas 6 & 14: LGL or LLLL; 8 & 16 end G
rawDefinition.notes: A distinct Telugu rule entry: it shares the 3/5/3/5 four-mātrā skeleton with Kannada Kanda but retains Telugu terminology, yati, and prāsa provenance.

signatures.signature: gaṇas 6 & 14: LGL or LLLL; 8 & 16 end G

rawDefinition.name: kiriyakkara
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the classical three-gaṇa frame. Optional sung substitutions remain explicitly provisional.

rawDefinition.name: kusuma ṣaṭpadi
rawDefinition.notes: Checks all six quantitative lines and their short/extended relationship. The final two-mātrā cadence may be a Guru or resolved Laghu pair. Literary constraints remain provisional.

rawDefinition.name: lalita ragaḷe
rawDefinition.notes: Checks four five-mātrā gaṇas on every written line and pairwise end-rhyme. The entry remains provisional pending expert review.

rawDefinition.name: madanavatī (Nāgavarma)
rawDefinition.notes: Implements Nāgavarma's primary five-Viṣṇu-plus-Guru realization. The equal-mātrā 4V+R division is documented but remains unchecked until whole-line alternative aṃśa divisions are supported.

rawDefinition.name: madhyākkara (Telugu)
signatureLines: 4 long pādas × (I I S) + (I I S)
yati at the fourth gaṇa; prāsa required
rawDefinition.notes: Nannaya's naturalized akkara form as described by Brown; later handbooks sometimes place the internal yati on the fifth rather than fourth gaṇa.

signatures.signature: 4 long pādas × (I I S) + (I I S)
yati at the fourth gaṇa; prāsa required

rawDefinition.name: mandānila ragaḷe
signatureLines: a gaṇa may not begin LG; adjacent lines use antya-prāsa
rawDefinition.notes: Checks repeatable line rhythm, the documented 3+5 alternative, lagam restriction, and pairwise end-rhyme. The entry remains provisional pending expert review.

signatures.signature: a gaṇa may not begin LG; adjacent lines use antya-prāsa

rawDefinition.name: mañjarī dvipada (Telugu)
rawDefinition.notes: The prāsa-free relative of dvipada; historical practice may use prāsa-yati.

rawDefinition.name: mutyāla sarālu (Telugu)
rawDefinition.notes: Gurajada's four-line song gait. The closing line may contain any total from seven through fourteen mātrās; word music remains an essential part of the form.

rawDefinition.name: naḍuvaṇakkara
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the classical five-gaṇa frame. Optional sung substitutions remain explicitly provisional.

rawDefinition.name: pañcamātrā chaupadi (Kagga form)
signatureLines: the final written Laghu may lengthen at the line ending
rawDefinition.notes: Recognizes the modal written-text frame used by D. V. Gundappa's Mankuthimmana Kagga, including opening dvitīyākṣara-prāsa and line-ending antya-prāsa. It is intentionally narrower than the broader historical mātrā-chaupadi family. Recitational lengthening, śithila-dvitva, and less common variants await an expert-reviewed corpus.

signatures.signature: the final written Laghu may lengthen at the line ending

rawDefinition.name: parivardhinī ṣaṭpadi
rawDefinition.notes: Checks all six quantitative lines, including the extended third and sixth lines. Literary constraints remain provisional pending expert corpus review.

rawDefinition.name: piriyakkara
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the classical seven-gaṇa frame and the specifically documented Brahma alternatives in positions two and four. Broader sung substitutions remain unchecked.

rawDefinition.name: sāṅgatya
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the common Sāṅgatya aṃśa frame and opening dvitīyākṣara-prāsa. Melodic substitutions are historically normal and remain compatible rather than being silently rejected as a complete rule.

rawDefinition.name: śara ṣaṭpadi
rawDefinition.notes: Checks all six quantitative lines and their short/extended relationship. The final two-mātrā cadence may be a Guru or resolved Laghu pair. Literary constraints remain provisional.

rawDefinition.name: sīsamu (Telugu)
signatureLines: 4 long pādas × I I I I I I S S
each long pāda may be written as 4+4 gaṇa half-lines
normally followed by a 4-pāda āṭaveladi or tēṭagīti ettugīti
rawDefinition.notes: Recognizes the four-long-line and eight-half-line conventions, plus canonical āṭaveladi or tēṭagīti ettugīti layouts. Prāsa is optional.

rawDefinition.name: taruvoja (Telugu)
signatureLines: 4 long pādas × (I I I S) + (I I I S)
may be displayed as 8 dvipada-like half-lines
rawDefinition.notes: The traditional extended-dvipada frame. Historical descriptions differ in how the written long lines and prāsa-governed half-lines are counted.

rawDefinition.name: tēṭagīti (Telugu)
signatureLines: 4 pādas × S I I S S
rawDefinition.notes: One Sūrya, two Indra, and two Sūrya gaṇas in every pāda. Prāsa is not required.

signatures.signature: 4 pādas × S I I S S

rawDefinition.name: folk tripadi (Kannada)
signatureLines: 5555 | 5455 | 545; gaṇa-final Laghu may be sung long (ಽ)
uncheckedRules: expansion and elision beyond one mātrā
rawDefinition.notes: Recognizes the later folk mātrā frame independently of classical aṃśa Tripadi. A gaṇa-final Laghu may supply one inferred sung mātrā; the analyzer marks that realization with a superscript avagraha without changing the poem.

signatures.signature: 5555 | 5455 | 545; gaṇa-final Laghu may be sung long (ಽ)

rawDefinition.name: tripadi (Kannada)
signatureLines: VVVV | VBVV | VBV; gaṇas 6 and 10 are Brahma
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the core aṃśa frame, required Brahma positions, opening dvitīyākṣara-prāsa, and its internal recurrence in the first line's third gaṇa. Sung and folk substitutions remain explicitly provisional.

signatures.signature: VVVV | VBVV | VBV; gaṇas 6 and 10 are Brahma

rawDefinition.name: mātrā tripadi (historical Kannada)
rawDefinition.notes: Represents the historical mātrā-gaṇa Tripadi frame separately from both classical aṃśa Tripadi and the later folk 5555 | 5455 | 545 realization.

rawDefinition.name: uddaṇḍa ṣaṭpadi
rawDefinition.notes: Checks the five/five/eight four-mātrā-gaṇa arrangement over all six lines. Literary and recitational variants remain provisional.

rawDefinition.name: utsāha ragaḷe
signatureLines: unbounded lines; 4 or 8 gaṇas per line
rawDefinition.notes: Checks either four or eight three-mātrā gaṇas on every written line and pairwise end-rhyme. The entry remains provisional pending expert review.

rawDefinition.name: vārdhaka ṣaṭpadi
rawDefinition.notes: Checks four five-mātrā gaṇas in the short lines and six plus the final cadence in lines three and six. Literary constraints remain provisional.

verses.text:
कश्चित्कान्ताविरहगुरुणा स्वाधिकारात्प्रमत्तः
शापेनास्तङ्गमितमहिमा वर्षभोग्येण भर्तुः । 
यक्षश्चक्रे जनकतनयास्नानपुण्योदकेषु
स्निग्धच्छायातरुषु वसतिं रामगिर्याश्रमेषु॥१.१॥

तस्मिन्नद्रौ कतिचिदबलाविप्रयुक्तः स कामी
नीत्वा मासान् कनकवलयभ्रंशरिक्तप्रकोष्ठः । 
आषाढस्य प्रथमदिवसे मेघमाश्लिष्टसानुं
वप्रक्रीडापरिणतगजप्रेक्षणीयं ददर्श॥१.२॥

तस्य स्थित्वा कथमपि पुरः कौतुकाधानहेतो-
रन्तर्बाष्पश्चिरमनुचरो राजराजस्य दध्यौ ।
मेघालोके भवति सुखिनोऽप्यन्यथावृत्ति चेतः
कण्ठाश्लेषप्रणयिनि जने किं पुनर्दूरसंस्थे॥१.३॥

प्रत्यासन्ने नभसि दयिताजीवितालम्बनार्थी
जीमूतेन स्वकुशलमयीं हारयिष्यन्प्रवृत्तिम् ।
स प्रत्यग्रैः कुटजकुसुमैः कल्पितार्घाय तस्मै
प्रीतः प्रीतिप्रमुखवचनं स्वागतं व्याजहार॥१.४॥

धूमज्योतिःसलिलमरुतां संनिपातः क्व मेघः
सन्देशार्थाः क्व पटुकरणैः प्राणिभिः प्रापणीयाः । 
इत्यौत्सुक्यादपरिगणयन् गुह्यकस्तं ययाचे
कामार्ता हि प्रकृतिकृपणाश्चेतनाचेतनेषु॥१.५॥

గాలి లేని దీప - కళిక చందంబున,
లలు ససుళ్లు లేని జలధి రీతి;
నిశ్చలాత్మయెన్న నిర్వికారంబున
నుండెనే'ని, ముక్తియండ్రు వేమ.
